name: Volumetric Display using Rotating Mirror (VRDM)
aliases: Volumetric Display using Rotating Mirror (vdrm) optical simulation & encoding
definition: A simulation and encoding pipeline for a volumetric display that uses a rotating mirror and surrounding LED screens. It maps 3D voxel coordinates to 2D screen pixels per rotation angle by applying mirror reflection matrices and handling pixel overlaps via depth sorting.
summary: VRDM projects 3D voxel data onto a rotating mirror using surrounding LED screens, avoiding per-pixel ray tracing by computing direct projections for each rotation angle.
